steps.en: Install the serve extra and start the local endpoint
steps.zh: 装好 serve extra，在本地起服务
steps.code: uv sync --extra serve · python -m kev.serve --run jaredpalmer/kev-4b

steps.en: Downloads the Qwen3.5 base and the LoRA adapter, merges them in fp32
steps.zh: 下载 Qwen3.5 底座与 LoRA adapter，在 fp32 下合并

steps.en: POST one state plus typed questions — noul, choice or score
steps.zh: 发一个请求：一段正文，加一组带类型的问题

steps.en: Encodes the text once and scores every option with the pointer head
steps.zh: 只编码一次正文，用 pointer head 给每个选项打分

steps.en: Returns a calibrated distribution per question; the stored temperature is already applied
steps.zh: 每题返回已校准的概率分布；温度参数在加载时已生效

steps.en: Fine-tune on your own labels when your questions differ
steps.zh: 问题不一样时，用你自己的标注做微调

steps.en: Warm-starts the released adapter, so your labels add a domain instead of retraining
steps.zh: 热启动已发布的 adapter：你的标注是加一个域，不是从头再训

value.en: You get thresholdable per-question probabilities on your own hardware — no hosted decision API, no from-scratch classifier
value.zh: 你拿到可设阈值的逐问题概率，跑在自己的硬件上——不依赖托管判定 API，也不用从零训分类器

sources: README → Quick Start (`uv sync --extra serve`; `KEV_DTYPE=bf16 uv run --extra serve python -m kev.serve --run jaredpalmer/kev-4b --port 8009`; curl against `localhost:8009/v1/systemone`)
README → API → `POST /v1/systemone` (one `state` plus typed `questions`: `noul` / `choice` / `score`; answers carry probabilities, `confidence`, `probabilities`; invalid requests return 422)
README → Serving Performance ("For the attention-only models the server merges the LoRA weights in fp32 before casting", state-prefix cache for repeated requests)

README → How It Works (the pointer head scores each option's `</opt>` hidden state against the question's `<decide>` hidden state; softmax into probabilities; Qwen3.5 hybrid DeltaNet rows isolate each question exactly and the server computes the state once and reuses its cache)

README → Models ("Probabilities are calibrated by default. Each checkpoint stores a temperature (about 2.1–2.4) fitted on its in-distribution development set, and the pointer head applies it when the model is loaded.")
README → Fine-tuning on your own data (`--init_from` "loads the adapter and pointer head from the released model before training, so you keep what Kev already knows and add your domain on top")
AGENTS.md → Notes (serving path: "LoRA merged in fp32 then cast (`KEV_MERGE=0` to keep unmerged)"; state-prefix KV cache; parity tests in tests/test_v3.py)
